fn solve(n: Int, k: Int, powers: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires (n > 0)
  requires (k > 0)
  requires (k <= n)
  requires ((n % k) == 0)
  requires (len(powers) == n)
  ensures (1 <= result)
  ensures (result <= k)
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0, []) == 0)
